functions.name: shot_set_vol
functions.signature: void shot_set_vol(uint port, uint vol, uint fade)
functions.plate:
Host 0x15 sdShotSetVol. r0 port, r1 vol (+0x80 biased), r2 fade ms.
r12 = &g_pcm_player[port&7]; joins the pstm_set_vol body at 0x6E30: flags|=CHG_VOL, pcm_fade_calc,
vol_target/interval/count/step; fade 0 -> volume = target at once. pcm_next_ch then returns (no channel bits in r0).

functions.name: pstm_set_vol
functions.signature: void pstm_set_vol(uint pmask, uint vol0, uint fade0, uint vol1, uint fade1)

functions.name: pcm_next_ch
functions.signature: void pcm_next_ch(uint pmask, PcmPlayer * pl, uint val1, uint fade1)
functions.plate:
Channel-mask stepper of pstm_set_vol/pan. If pmask bit4 (ch1) is clear: pops the entry lr and returns from the
whole command. Else clears bit4, r12 += 0x58 (ch1 player), r1 = r4, r2 = r5 and returns to the body.

functions.name: shot_set_pan
functions.signature: void shot_set_pan(uint port, uint pan, uint fade)
functions.plate:
Host 0x16 sdShotSetPan. r0 port, r1 pan (+0x80), r2 fade ms. Joins the pan body 0x6EB8:
flags|=CHG_PAN, pan_target/interval/count/step; fade 0 -> pan = target.

functions.name: pstm_set_pan
functions.signature: void pstm_set_pan(uint pmask, uint pan0, uint fade0, uint pan1, uint fade1)
functions.plate: Host 0x26 sdPstmSetPan. r0 = port | 0x20 (ch0) | 0x10 (ch1); r1/r2 ch0 pan/fade, r4/r5 ch1. Pan analogue of pstm_set_vol.

functions.name: pcm_fade_calc
functions.signature: uint pcm_fade_calc(uint target, uint fade, uint cur)
functions.plate:
Fade step for the 4 ms tick. In r1 target, r2 fade ms, r7 current. Out r3 step, r2 interval (ticks between steps).
interval = fade>>2, diff = |cur-target|&0xFF; halve both until diff<=1 (interval then clamped to 0xFF) or interval<=1.
fade 0 -> r3 = 0 (immediate).

functions.name: shot_set_fx_ch
functions.signature: void shot_set_fx_ch(uint port, uint in_ch, uint base_lvl)
functions.plate:
Host 0x19 sdShotSetFxCh. r0 port, r1 DSP input ch (0xFF = sample default), r2 base level (+0x80, bits 7:4 kept).
fx_base = r2&0xF0; fx_ch = in_ch+0x40 (bit6 = override). If playing: dsp_send byte = in_ch (or sample ISEL) + pcm_level_mix(fx_lvl, base>>4)<<4.
QUIRK: in_ch 0xFF stores stale r4 (host_cmd_exec leaves 0x1340C -> 0x0C, bit6 clear = no override).

functions.name: pstm_set_fx_ch
functions.signature: void pstm_set_fx_ch(uint port, uint in_ch, uint base_lvl)
functions.plate:
Host 0x29 sdPstmSetFxCh. As shot_set_fx_ch for both stream channels (r8 = 2 passes, joins 0x6F78).
fx_ch byte (r4) is computed once before the pass loop (0x6F88), so both channels get the same byte.
QUIRK: in_ch 0xFF with ch0 playing replaces r1 by ch0's isel; if ch1 plays too, its dsp_send becomes
ch0.isel + mix(fx_lvl, fx_base>>4)<<4 (FxCh base, not its own isel/imxl) while its fx_ch stays 0x0C (no override).

functions.name: shot_set_fx_lvl
functions.signature: void shot_set_fx_lvl(uint port, uint lvl)
functions.plate:
Host 0x1A sdShotSetFxLev. r0 port, r1 level (+0x80). fx_lvl = r1; if playing IMXL = pcm_level_mix(r1, (fx_ch&0x40 ? fx_base : imxl)>>4).
0x7038.. is also the tail of pcm_apply_params (r8 = 1).

functions.name: pstm_set_fx_lvl
functions.signature: void pstm_set_fx_lvl(uint port, uint lvl)
functions.plate: Host 0x2A sdPstmSetFxLev. As shot_set_fx_lvl for both channels of the stream port (r8 = 2).

functions.name: shot_set_direct_lvl
functions.signature: void shot_set_direct_lvl(uint port, uint lvl)
functions.plate:
Host 0x1B sdShotSetDrctLev. r0 port, r1 level (+0x80). direct_lvl = r1; if playing DISDL = pcm_level_mix(r1, disdl_base)
-> pl->disdl and channel byte 0x25.

functions.name: pstm_set_direct_lvl
functions.signature: void pstm_set_direct_lvl(uint port, uint lvl)
functions.plate: Host 0x2B sdPstmSetDrctLev. As shot_set_direct_lvl for both stream channels.

functions.name: pcm_level_mix
functions.signature: uint pcm_level_mix(uint lvl, uint base)
functions.plate: r7 = clamp(((base<<3) + lvl - 0x80) asr 3, 0, 15): host level (+0x80 biased) applied to a 4-bit base (IMXL/DISDL).

functions.name: pcm_player_slot_a
functions.signature: PcmSlot * pcm_player_slot_a(PcmPlayer * pl)
functions.plate: r10 = &g_pcm_slot[pl->slot], r11 = r10->ch (clobbers r7, r9). Same as pcm_player_slot (0x8240).

functions.name: shot_play
functions.signature: void shot_play(uint port, uint num, uint prio, SosbHeader * bank)

functions.name: pstm_play
functions.signature: void pstm_play(uint port, uint fmt, uint banks, uint tl, uint freq, uint prio)
functions.plate:
Host 0x21 sdPstmPlay. r0 port, r1 fmt (PCMS), r2 banks = bank0 | bank1<<8 | stereo<<16, r3 base vol (TL), r4 freq (OCT/FNS),
r5 prio<<3. Per channel (ch0 kind 2, ch1 kind 3 if stereo): pcm_slot_alloc; SPSR bank (0x14180+n*8) addr 0 -> err 1;
clamp ring (16-bit 0x1F000 / 8-bit 0xF000 / ADPCM 0x7000, PCMS forced 3), LEA = ring in samples; looping channel
(KYONB|LPCTL, LSA 0, AR 31, RR 0x15, LPOFF Q4, FLV 0x1FF8, LFORE); pan_base 0 mono / 0x1F L / 0x0F R; pcm_apply_params.
Keyed on with one KYONEX after the last channel. Mono on a port whose ch1 still plays: ch1 slot freed + key-off
(its PLAY flag is left set - QUIRK). ch0.loops_left keeps the bank word.
Note: pcm_key_exec_off (0x81EC) pops this routine's lr, so the mono path returns there; the b 0x81D8
after it (and the key-on the decompiler shows after it) never executes.

functions.name: pcm_slot_alloc
functions.signature: PcmSlot * pcm_slot_alloc(PcmPlayer * pl, uint prio, uint kind)
functions.plate:
Reserve one of AICA channels 48-63 for r12 (r5 prio 0..31, r0 kind 1 shot / 2 stream L / 3 stream R).
Out r10 slot, r11 channel, r9 index. Playing player: prio < own prio (both != 0) -> err 2 via 0x81C4, else re-use own slot.
Else first free slot (owner 0). Else victim scan 15..0: prio-0 slot taken at once, else lowest prio (ties: lowest
prio|kind<<8 word, lowest index); new prio 0 or > victim steals, < fails, == compares prio+kind with the word (QUIRK: always fails).
Fail -> err 0x80 (kind 3: stream ch0 released first; pstm_release leaves r12 = ch0+0x58, so the error lands on ch1). Steal: release owner (0x7F50 / 0x7EA4) + KYONEX key-off.
Claim: pl prio/slot, slot prio/kind/owner, PLAY, MSLC = 0x30+slot.
QUIRK: after the victim scan r9 = -1, so pl->slot = 0xFF and MSLC = 0x2F (channel 47) when a victim is stolen.

functions.name: pcm_apply_params
functions.signature: void pcm_apply_params(PcmPlayer * pl, AicaChannel * ch, uint tl, uint pan_base, uint pitch)

functions.name: pcm_apply_pitch
functions.signature: void pcm_apply_pitch(PcmPlayer * pl, AicaChannel * ch, uint pitch_base)
functions.plate:
PITCH = OCT/FNS of ((oct_flip(pitch_base>>11)<<10 | pitch_base&0x3FF) + pl->pitch_ofs); octave clamped to 15.
QUIRK: octave extracted with lsr, so negative sums clamp to the top octave (movlt is dead). Tail of pcm_update (0x730C).

functions.name: shot_stop
functions.signature: void shot_stop(uint port)
functions.plate: Host 0x12 sdShotStop. If playing: pcm_player_slot, shot_release, KYONEX key-off (0x81EC).

functions.name: pstm_stop
functions.signature: void pstm_stop(uint port)
functions.plate: Host 0x22 sdPstmStop. If ch0 playing: pstm_release (ch0 + ch1) and KYONEX key-off.

functions.name: pstm_release
functions.signature: AicaChannel * pstm_release(PcmPlayer * pl, PcmSlot * slot, AicaChannel * ch)
functions.plate:
Stop a stream: for r12 (assumed ch0) and then ch1 if playing: pcm_slot_free keeping fx_ch, KYONB off (no KYONEX),
loop_mode = start = ring_len = 0, pan_base 0x1F / 0x0F, disdl_base 0x0F, PLAY cleared.
QUIRK: called by pcm_slot_alloc for a stolen ch1 too -> treats it as ch0 and also stops the next player.
Returns r11 = last channel handled (caller keys it off). Side effect: r12 is always left at pl+0x58
(pcm_slot_alloc's kind-3 failure path relies on it).

functions.name: shot_stop_all
functions.signature: void shot_stop_all(void)
functions.plate: Host 0x1F sdShotStopAll (and 0x80 with cmd[3]). shot_release every slot of kind 1, then one KYONEX (slot 15's register).

functions.name: shot_release
functions.signature: void shot_release(PcmPlayer * pl, PcmSlot * slot, AicaChannel * ch)
functions.plate: pcm_release (keeping fx_ch), clear PLAY, KYONB off (caller executes KYONEX). r6 = 0.

functions.name: pstm_stop_all
functions.signature: void pstm_stop_all(void)
functions.plate:
Host 0x2F sdPstmStopAll (and 0x80 with cmd[4]). For each slot of kind 2/3: pcm_slot_free keeping fx_ch, disdl_base 0xF,
PLAY and KYONB off, loop_mode/start/ring_len 0, pan_base 0x1F (kind 2) / 0x0F (kind 3). Then one KYONEX.

functions.name: shot_pause
functions.signature: void shot_pause(uint port)
functions.plate:
Host 0x13 (not sent by sd 1.00.18). flags |= PAUSE; if playing: key-off (release). If loops_left == 1 the slot is
released and PLAY cleared too. Not a real pause: shot_continue restarts the sample.

functions.name: shot_continue
functions.signature: void shot_continue(uint port)
functions.plate: Host 0x14 (not sent by sd 1.00.18). If PAUSE: clear it; if still PLAY: key on again (0x81D8) = restart from SA.

functions.name: shot_reset_prm_all
functions.signature: void shot_reset_prm_all(void)
functions.plate:
Host 0x1E with port 0xFF (sdShotResetAllPrm). shot_reset_prm loop over 16 players from 0x11000.
QUIRK: only 8 are one-shots; stream ports 0-3 get ring_len/loop_mode zeroed too.

functions.name: shot_reset_prm
functions.signature: void shot_reset_prm(uint port)
functions.plate:
Host 0x1E sdShotResetPrm. ring_len (loop param) = loop_mode = 0; playing -> pcm_reset_ch_regs else pcm_reset_fields.
The loop counter r7 (1) is decremented in 0x81B4, which returns from here when it reaches 0.

functions.name: pstm_reset_prm_all
functions.signature: void pstm_reset_prm_all(void)
functions.plate: Host 0x2E with port 0xFF (sdPstmResetAllPrm): parameter defaults for all 16 stream channels.

functions.name: pstm_reset_prm
functions.signature: void pstm_reset_prm(uint port)
functions.plate: Host 0x2E sdPstmResetPrm: parameter defaults for both channels of the stream port (r7 = 2).

functions.name: pcm_reset_ch_regs
functions.signature: void pcm_reset_ch_regs(PcmPlayer * pl, AicaChannel * ch, uint zero, uint count)
functions.plate:
Playing player: TL = tl_base, DIPAN = pan_base, IMXL from imxl<<4 (QUIRK: imxl is already <<4 -> IMXL 0), DISDL = disdl_base;
falls into pcm_reset_fields.

functions.name: pcm_reset_fields
functions.signature: void pcm_reset_fields(PcmPlayer * pl, uint zero, uint count)
functions.plate:
Host-parameter defaults: speed/pitch target+current 0x8000 (0 then 0x80 into byte 1), fade state 0, pitch_ofs 0,
vol/pan target+current, fx_lvl, direct_lvl = 0x80, fx_ch = 0x80; clear CHG_VOL/CHG_PAN.
Tail 0x81B4: --r7; 0 -> pop entry lr and return from the command, else r12 += 0x58 and return to the loop.

functions.name: pcm_key_exec_off
functions.signature: void pcm_key_exec_off(AicaChannel * ch)
functions.plate: Shared exit: ch->ctl = (ctl & ~KYONB) | KYONEX (executes key on/off of all channels), then pops the entry lr and returns.

functions.name: pcm_release
functions.signature: void pcm_release(PcmPlayer * pl, PcmSlot * slot, uint zero)
functions.plate: loops_default = loops_left = start = r6 (0), then falls into pcm_slot_free.

functions.name: pcm_slot_free
functions.signature: void pcm_slot_free(PcmPlayer * pl, PcmSlot * slot, uint zero)
functions.plate:
Free the slot (owner, prio/kind word = 0) and zero pl prio, slot, pitch_base, tl, dipan, vol/pan counters and the
words +0x24 (tl_base,isel,imxl,pcms) and +0x28 (pan_base,fx_ch,disdl_base,disdl). Flags untouched.

functions.name: pcm_player_slot
functions.signature: PcmSlot * pcm_player_slot(PcmPlayer * pl)
functions.plate: r10 = &g_pcm_slot[pl->slot] (r9 = slot, r4 = 12 clobbered), r11 = r10->ch.

functions.name: shot_set_loop_mode
functions.signature: void shot_set_loop_mode(uint port, uint mode, uint param)
functions.plate:
Host 0x1C (no sd 1.00.18 API). r0 port, r1 mode 0..2 (>2 -> err 0x20 via 0x81C4, which pops the handler's lr),
r2 param (u32). loop_mode = mode+1, ring_len = param; if flags byte != 0 falls into shot_loops_apply.
Modes: 1 default+param, 2 default*param>>8, 3 param (loops_left = loop passes, 0 = forever).

functions.name: shot_loops_apply
functions.signature: void shot_loops_apply(PcmPlayer * pl, uint mode, uint param)
functions.plate: loops_left via jump table 0x8298: 0 loops_default, 1 loops_default+param, 2 (loops_default*param)>>8, 3 param.

labels.name: k_sosb_tag
labels.comment: 'SOSB' literal in front of shot_play; unreferenced (the handler uses 0x52DC)

labels.name: pcm_err_exit
labels.comment: pl->err |= r4; pop entry lr; return

comments.text: ch0 selected? else pcm_next_ch -> ch1 or return
no ch1 bit: return from the whole command
fx_ch = in_ch+0x40 (override), once for all passes; r4 is stale when in_ch == 0xFF (0x1340C -> 0x0C)
0xFF: sample ISEL; QUIRK r1 stays replaced, so a playing ch1 gets ch0's ISEL and the fx_base level
num > count -> err 4 (num == count accepted: off by one)
ctl|sa_lo halves swapped: SA[22:0] in bits 22:0
QUIRK: bits 24:23 of the word = SA_LO bits 8:7, not PCMS
loops_default = SOSP loop count (byte store; bytes 1-3 stay 0)
dummy monitor reads after MSLC select
ADPCM: clamp 0x7000, LEA = bytes*2, PCMS = 3 (long-stream ADPCM)
pan_base 0x0F: this was ch1 -> key on both
mono: is a stale ch1 still playing?
free ch1's slot; QUIRK: its PLAY flag is not cleared
KYONEX: ch1 off, ch0 (KYONB set) on; 0x81EC pops pstm_play's lr, 0x7B44 never runs
no ring: undo the claim (prio byte kept)
new prio >= own -> re-use own slot, else err 2
victim scan: min prio in r6, entry in r8
prio 0 slot: take it at once (r9 valid)
r9 = -1 from here on (QUIRK: stored as pl->slot)
QUIRK: prio + kind vs prio | kind<<8 -> never >=
fail; stream ch1 -> release ch0 first
err 0x80: no channel (kind 3: r12 = ch1 again after pstm_release)
FxCh override? ISEL = fx_ch (incl. bit6; IMXL rewritten below)
tail into the FxLev body with r8 = 1
QUIRK: lsr, so negative -> huge -> clamps to 15
QUIRK: assumes r12 was ch0; r12 stays advanced on return
PAUSE set even if not playing
last loop pass -> release the slot
QUIRK: 16 players from 0x11000 (8 shots + stream ports 0-3)
QUIRK: imxl already <<4 -> IMXL 0 after byte store
accumulate error bits (host copies them to status +0x1C)
any flag set (not just PLAY) -> apply now
